pkgmetadata.longdescription: ipmifand is a small C daemon that controls server fans through IPMI from CPU temperature (via ipmitool) and disk temperature (via smartctl). One binary supports several hardware profiles selected in INI configuration: named profiles for Supermicro X10DRC, Supermicro X10DRU-i+, and ASRock Rack X570D4U-2L2T boards that verify the DMI vendor and board name, plus a command-template mode compatible with earlier releases. The named profiles use the local /dev/ipmi0 interface, apply 100 percent duty on start, on any sensor, disk, RPM, or command failure, and before exit, and only follow the configured temperature-to-duty curves after the board passes its readback checks.

ipmifand 是一个小型 C 守护进程，根据 CPU 温度（通过 ipmitool）和磁盘 温度（通过 smartctl）经由 IPMI 控制服务器风扇。单个二进制通过 INI 配置选择多种硬件 profile：适用于 Supermicro X10DRC、Supermicro X10DRU-i+ 和 ASRock Rack X570D4U-2L2T 主板的命名 profile（会校验 DMI 厂商与板型），以及兼容早期版本的命令模板模式。命名 profile 使用本地 /dev/ipmi0 接口，在启动、任何传感器/磁盘/RPM/命令故障以及退出前都将 占空比设为 100%，仅在主板通过回读校验后才按配置的温度-占空比曲线 调速。
